items.title: Korea arrests suspects selling intimate videos from hacked IP cameras
items.description: The Korean National Police have arrested four individuals suspected of hacking over 120,000 IP cameras across the country and then selling stolen footage to a foreign adult site. [...]

items.title: Iran's 'MuddyWater' Levels Up With MuddyViper Backdoor
items.description: New Fooder loader and memory-only tactics suggest MuddyWater has evolved from its usual noisy ops to more stealthy espionage operations.
